description: PLANNED as its own grant: change an object's lifecycle (roadmap §30.2 media.lifecycle.transition): restore a soft-deleted object within retention, place or release retention holds (moderation, dmca, creator_pin, admin, evidence), and move VOD bytes between storage tiers. Soft delete itself is DELETE /api/v2/:app/objects/:id; no route sets archived. Today restore checks media.object.upload and holds and tier moves take an app key only.
